definitions.explanation: A word made from the first letters of a series of words, whether read as a word (NATO) or letter by letter (NHK).

examples.japanese: NHK⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{頭字語|とうじご}だ。
{頭字語|とうじご}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{多|おお}すぎて⟦{資料|しりょう}→資料：04166_shiryou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{読|よ}み→読む：00426_yomu⟧にくい。
examples.english: The document is hard to read because it has too many acronyms.

examples.japanese: NATOやUNESCO⟦のように→のように：30291_noyouni⟧、⟦{単語|たんご}→単語：03413_tango⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{頭文字|かしらもじ}→頭文字：32722_kashiramoji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{並|なら}べて→並べる：01091_naraberu⟧⟦{作|つく}った→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{頭字語|とうじご}⟦という→という：09577_toiu⟧。
examples.english: Words made by lining up the initial letters of words, like NATO and UNESCO, are called acronyms.

notes:
USAGE:
A linguistics term, covering both acronyms read as words and initialisms read letter by letter (JR, NHK). Everyday speech just says ⟦{略語|りゃくご}→略語：21705_ryakugo⟧ or ⟦{略称|りゃくしょう}→略称：13562_ryakushou⟧.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{略語|りゃくご}→略語：21705_ryakugo⟧: any abbreviation, including clipped words such as ⟦スマホ→スマホ：04721_sumaho⟧; {頭字語|とうじご} covers only those made of initial letters.
- ⟦{頭文字|かしらもじ}→頭文字：32722_kashiramoji⟧: an initial letter itself
